name: Maya Okafor
profile: Maya (she/her) finished an MS in Information Management in May 2026 and is targeting business development rep roles at SaaS companies.

facts.text: Led a five-person consulting-club project that cut a nonprofit's donor churn by 12 percent
The consulting-club result was actually a 15 percent drop in donor churn once the final quarter's data came in
Cold-called 40 alumni in one week to fill a career-fair sponsor gap and landed three sponsors
As campus IT help desk lead, calmed an angry professor by walking them through a live data-recovery fix
Built a Tableau dashboard of library study-room bookings that the library still uses
Rambles on 'tell me about yourself', running past two minutes
Her openers land when she leads with a number
Forgets to ask the interviewer questions at the end
Velloway Analytics recruiter screen booked for Thursday October 8 at 2pm
Velloway Analytics moved the recruiter screen to Friday October 9 at 11am
Corvid Labs rejected her for the SDR role after the hiring-manager round
A Corvid Labs recruiter reached out about a new BDR team opening in November
Quillbase sent a take-home: a 30-60-90 day plan due October 2
Tessellate final-round panel on Monday October 19 with four interviewers
Gets nervous before panel interviews; her mind goes blank with more than two people in the room
Felt flat and discouraged the day after the Corvid rejection
Felt energized after a mock where her opener landed
Wants a referral at Tessellate and knows a classmate there, Priya

sessions.outline: First session. Maya introduces her search, tells the consulting-club story, and admits panels make her nervous.
Mock BDR screen. Her 'tell me about yourself' rambles. She tells the alumni cold-calling story. Wren debriefs.
Corvid Labs rejected her after the hiring-manager round. She feels flat.
Mock with a hiring-manager persona. She tells the help desk story and opens with a number, which lands. She feels energized.
Logistics: the Quillbase take-home and a newly booked Velloway screen.
Mock for Quillbase. She tells the Tableau dashboard story and forgets to ask questions at the end.
Velloway moved her screen. She also corrects the consulting-club number.
Surprise: Corvid Labs is back in touch about a different opening.
The Tessellate final round is a four-person panel. Wren nudges her toward a referral and she names a classmate.
Panel-style mock prep. She retells the alumni story and talks about panel nerves.
